findings.reconciliationEvidence: RECONCILED FIXED on mainnet fork @ block 25242176 (HEAD 30775401, /audit-script dispatcher-replace-sky-pooler regression follow-up, run phoenix-phase-2-staging-10). The rewrite adds BalancerPoolerV2(newPooler).setMinter(NFT_MINTER_V2) at step 6, guarded by an unconditional require(vm.load(newPooler, slot1) == NFT_MINTER_V2) that runs on the broadcast path (fail-closed before replaceDispatcher), plus a preview-only e2e mint(4) proof at step 16. Verified 3 ways: (1) the run-09 reproduction PoC test/AuditSkyPoolerMintIndex4.t.sol NO LONGER reverts (fix confirmed, not bit-rot — the test's expectRevert now fails because mint(4) succeeds); (2) new PoC test/AuditSkyPoolerMintIndex4_Fixed.t.sol shows a fresh user mints id-4 after the cutover alone; (3) preview step-16 mints id-4 to the owner.
findings.proposedStatusReason: Empirically reconciled FIXED at HEAD 30775401 (3-way fork-verified, block 25242176). Status preserved as `acknowledged` (human triage status, authoritative) and NOT auto-overwritten by the pipeline. Run `/ledger phoenix-phase-2-staging` to mark M-01 fixed.

findings.title: Broadcast uses --skip-simulation with an offline-derived stale-able minBPT; no live re-query enforced
findings.reconciliationNote: STILL-OPEN (mitigated, not closed) at HEAD 30775401 (fork @ block 25242176, run phoenix-phase-2-staging-10). The rewrite wraps pool() in a try/catch (step 17) so a too-high stale floor that reverts pool() no longer rolls back or strands the already-committed dispatcher cutover — it logs 'LP add DEFERRED', parks the seeded sUSDS recoverably for a later manual re-pool (fork-proven: forced MIN_BPT_WEI=1e23 reverts pool() but cutover stays committed and step-16 mint(4) still succeeds). RESIDUAL (keeps L-01 open): no live in-script minBPT re-query was added; the floor is still the offline DEFAULT_MIN_BPT=284e18 / MIN_BPT_WEI env constant, broadcast still carries --skip-simulation. A stale-too-low floor still weakens slippage protection on the single LP add; a stale-too-high floor silently defers the LP add. The run-09 worst case (stranded half-cutover) is resolved; the weak-slippage / silent-LP-deferral residual persists.
